name: Advanced Menu Builder for Elementor
author: naziraljiwala11

sections.description:
Nexus Nav transforms the standard WordPress navigation into a powerful, fully customizable design system integrated directly with Elementor.

Unlock the power of Mega Menus by using any Elementor Template as a submenu. Design complex layouts with maps, contact forms, or product grids, and simply link them to your menu items.

🌟 Key Features

  • Mega Menu Customization: Use Elementor Templates as submenus for unlimited design possibilities.
  • Elementor Widget: A dedicated “Nexus Nav Menu” widget with advanced styling controls.
  • Dual Menu Support: specific unique feature allowing different menus for Desktop and Mobile within a single widget.
  • Responsive Layouts: Choose from Horizontal, Vertical, or Hamburger (Off-Canvas) layouts.
  • Custom Icons: Add FontAwesome icons or upload custom SVGs to your menu items directly from the WP Menu screen.
  • Advanced Styling: Full control over typography, colors, borders, shadows, and spacing.
  • Mobile Breakpoints: Precision control over when your menu switches to the mobile hamburger toggle.
  • One-Click Duplication: Easily duplicate existing menus to experiment with new structures.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Optimized for performance with no bloat.

🚀 How It Works

  1. Create: Go to Appearance > Menus.
  2. Enhance: Use the new “Nexus Nav Settings” on menu items to add icons or enable Mega Menus.
  3. Display: Drag the “Nexus Nav Menu” widget into any Elementor page or header.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nexus-menu folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Appearance > Menus to configure your menu structure.
  4. Open Elementor and use the Nexus Nav Menu widget to display it.
